## OnePay - Software Engineer, Credit Card

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend engineer building secure APIs and distributed systems for OnePay’s co-branded credit card. Owning reliability, compliance, and performance across real-time financial transactions.
Backend engineer building secure credit-card infrastructure for OnePay’s consumer fintech platform
- Salary: $140,000 - $190,000 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Java, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Microservices, Node.js, TypeScript, Go

- Design and build backend services powering OnePay’s co-branded credit card product and partner integrations
- Architect APIs and event-driven systems handling sensitive financial data securely at scale
- Partner with risk, compliance, and platform teams to meet regulatory and security requirements
- Own reliability and performance for systems processing real-time credit transactions
- Drive technical decisions on system design, balancing scalability, security, and delivery speed
- Mentor engineers and improve code quality, testing, and operational practices
- Work with Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Kubernetes, AWS, and microservice-oriented architecture
- 3+ years of professional experience in backend or distributed systems development
- Experience building and operating production-grade APIs and microservices in a regulated or high-compliance environment (fintech, payments, banking, or similar)
- Proficiency in Node.js or similar modern backend frameworks (TypeScript, NestJS, Go, or Java)
- Familiarity with cloud-native architecture (Kubernetes, AWS) and event-driven or microservice-based systems
- Strong understanding of data security, PCI compliance, or similar standards protecting sensitive financial data
- Strong communication and collaboration skills across product, risk, and platform teams
- Drive and proactivity
- Familiarity with modern software engineering practices

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend engineer building secure APIs and distributed systems for OnePay’s co-branded credit card. Owning reliability, compliance, and performance across real-time financial transactions.
Backend engineer building secure credit-card infrastructure for OnePay’s consumer fintech platform
Role description:
• Design and build backend services powering OnePay’s co-branded credit card product and partner integrations
• Architect APIs and event-driven systems handling sensitive financial data securely at scale
• Partner with risk, compliance, and platform teams to meet regulatory and security requirements
• Own reliability and performance for systems processing real-time credit transactions
• Drive technical decisions on system design, balancing scalability, security, and delivery speed
• Mentor engineers and improve code quality, testing, and operational practices
• Work with Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Kubernetes, AWS, and microservice-oriented architecture
Role requirements:
• 3+ years of professional experience in backend or distributed systems development
• Experience building and operating production-grade APIs and microservices in a regulated or high-compliance environment (fintech, payments, banking, or similar)
• Proficiency in Node.js or similar modern backend frameworks (TypeScript, NestJS, Go, or Java)
• Familiarity with cloud-native architecture (Kubernetes, AWS) and event-driven or microservice-based systems
• Strong understanding of data security, PCI compliance, or similar standards protecting sensitive financial data
• Strong communication and collaboration skills across product, risk, and platform teams
• Drive and proactivity
• Familiarity with modern software engineering practices
• Authorization to work lawfully in the United States
• Must disclose whether OnePay sponsorship of an immigration case is required

• Flexible time off (FTO)

AWS, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Java, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Microservices, Node.js, TypeScript, Go
